title: Radeon RX 6900 XT Review & Benchmarks vs RTX 3090!
description:
Radeon RX 6900 XT Review & Benchmarks vs RTX 3090!
The Radeon RX 6900 XT launches today, so it's time to fire up the old test bed and see what this $1000 GPU is capable of. 
Games tested: Microsoft Flight Simulator 2020, Death Stranding, Shadow of the Tomb Raider, GTA V, Doom: Eternal, Metro:Exodus, Battlefield V, and 3DMark Time Spy Extreme and Port Royal Ray Tracing.
